rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse was revealed in 7 AH, the year of the compensatory umra, like the preceding verse.
rows.anchor: Bu âyet dahi mâkabli gibi Umre-i Kazâ Senesi denilen yedinci sene-i hicriyede nâzil olmuştur.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lexically, hajj means an important, weighty purpose rather than just any intention.
rows.anchor: Lâkin mutlak kasd değil, büyük ve ehemmiyetli bir şeye kasıddır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Legally, hajj is a visit to a specified place at a specified time through prescribed rites, including ihram, standing at Arafat, and circumambulation.
rows.anchor: Şer‘an: Zaman-ı mahsûsunda mekân-ı mahsûsa bir ziyâret-i mahsûsadır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ihram is a condition; standing at Arafat and tawaf are the pillars of both obligatory and voluntary hajj.
rows.anchor: İhram şart, vakfe ve tavaf da rükündür.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Validity requires Islam, intention with ihram, and the specified place and time; rites outside the hajj months are invalid.
rows.anchor: Şart-ı sıhhat: İslâm, niyet ile ihram, mekân ve zamân-ı mahsustur.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The obligation itself requires Islam, freedom, reason, adulthood, capacity, the proper time, and either residence in Muslim lands or knowledge of hajj's obligation in hostile lands.
rows.anchor: Birincisi nefs-i vücûbun şartıdır ki İslâm, hürriyet, akıl, büluğ, istitâ‘a, vakit, dâr-ı İslâm’da bulunmak veya dâr-ı harbde ise haccın farziyetini bilmiş olmaktır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Performance also requires bodily health, absence of practical impediments, safe travel, no waiting period for a woman, and her husband or a mahram with her.
rows.anchor: İkincisi de vücûb-i edânın şartıdır ki sıhhat-i beden, mevâni‘-i hissiye bulunmamak, emn-i tarîk ve kadın hakkında iddet beklemek olmamak, zevci veya mahremi beraber bulunmaktır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hajj duties include entering ihram by the miqat, extending Arafat standing until sunset, and standing at Muzdalifa.
rows.anchor: Arafat’ta vakfeyi gurûba kadar temdid etmek. 3. Müzdelife’de dahi vakfe yapmak.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Other duties include seven rounds of sa'y between Safa and Marwa after a valid tawaf and casting stones at the prescribed place.
rows.anchor: 4. Safâ ile Merve arasında yedi şavt sa‘y etmek. 5. Sa‘yi mu‘teddün bih bir tavaftan sonra yapmak. 6. Mevki‘-i mahsûsunda taş atmak.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The pilgrim must shave or shorten hair, perform the farewell tawaf if an outsider, and observe the listed starting point, direction, walking, purity, and covering rules for tawaf.
rows.anchor: 7. Halk veya taksîr, yani başını kazıtmak veya kırktırmak. 8. Âfâkī olanlar için “tavâf-ı sader” denilen vedâ‘tavâfı yapmak.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tawaf starts at the Black Stone and proceeds to the right; walking, ritual purity, and covering the private parts are required absent an excuse, while four of seven rounds are pillars.
rows.anchor: 9. Tavâfa Hacer-i Esved’den başlamak. 10. Tavâfı sağdan yapmak. 11. Özrü yoksa tavafta yürümek. 12. Tavafta hades-i asgar ve ekberden taharet üzere bulunmak. 13. Setr-i avret.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He also lists two-rak'a prayers after each seven tawaf rounds, sacrifices for qarin and mutamatti pilgrims, and the proper order between stoning and shaving.
rows.anchor: 16. Kārin veya mütemetti‘olanlar için kurban kesmek. 17. Her yedi tavafta iki rekat namaz kılmak. 18. Remy ile halk beyninde tertîbe riayet etmek.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The remaining duties include sacrifice on the Day of Sacrifice, shaving at its proper place and time, and tawaf al-ziyara during the sacrifice days; omitting any duty entails a dam.
rows.anchor: 19. Yevm-i nahrda kurban kesmek. 20. Halkı mekânında ve zamanında yapmak. 21. Tavâf-ı ziyâreti eyyâm-ı nahrda yapmak ki bu vâciblerden biri terk olunursa dem lâzım gelir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sunnahs include the arrival tawaf, ramal, running between the green markers, overnight stays at Mina, and the prescribed travel times between Mina, Arafat, and Muzdalifa.
rows.anchor: Tavâf-ı kudûm, yani Mekke’ye girince Kâbe’yi tavaf etmek, tavâf-ı kudûmda veya tavâf-ı farzda “remel” yapmak

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Prohibitions fall into acts forbidden to oneself, such as sex, hair or nail removal, perfume, and certain clothing, and acts forbidden against others, including shaving them or hunting; violations incur penalties.
rows.anchor: Haccın memnû‘âtı da iki nevidir. Birisi şahsın kendinde yapmaktan memnû‘olduğu şeylerdir ki: Cimâ‘, saç ve kıl izâle etmek, tırnak kesmek, koku sürünmek

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Shafi‘i school treats sa'y, and according to one view shaving or shortening, as obligatory pillars of hajj.
rows.anchor: Mezheb-i Şâfi‘î’de Safâ ile Merve arasında sa‘y ve bir kavilde halk veya taksîr dahi haccın farzlarından ve hatta erkânındandır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Kaaba is hajj's legal cause because the rite is attached to the singular, unique House.
rows.anchor: Haccın sebeb-i şer‘îsi Beytullâh’tır. Zira hac ona muzâf olur

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hajj is obligatory once in a Muslim's lifetime, immediately in the first year capacity permits.
rows.anchor: hac Müslümana ömründe bir kere fevren, yani ilk imkân senesinde farz olur.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some transmit that hajj is obligatory with delay, though hastening is better.
rows.anchor: Terâhî tarîkiyle farz olup ta‘cîl efdal olduğu da rivayet edilmiştir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet performed the compensatory umra in 7 AH, returned after three days under the Hudaybiya agreement, then led the conquest of Mecca, Hunayn, and Taif campaigns in 8 AH.
rows.anchor: Aleyhissalâtü vesselâm Efendimiz zilkadede umre suretiyle Kâbe’yi ziyaret etmiş ve bir sene evvel mümâna‘at-ı müşrikîn ile itmam edemediği umreyi bu vechile kazâ ettikten sonra ber vech-i musâlaha üç günden ziyade Mekke’de kalamayacaklarından kable’l-hac avdet buyurmuştu.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After the treaty was broken, the Prophet conquered Mecca in Ramadan 8 AH, fought at Hunayn, besieged Taif, performed another umra, and returned to Medina before hajj.
rows.anchor: ramazân-ı şerîfte hareket edilmiş ve ramazanın ‘aşr-ı ahîrinde Mekke feth olunmuş ve şevval içinde Huneyn muharebesi ve Tâif muhasarası yapılmış

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abu Bakr led the first Islamic hajj in 9 AH and announced that polytheists could no longer perform hajj or circumambulate naked.
rows.anchor: Hazret-i Ebû Bekir Sıddîk radıyallahu ‘anh taraf-ı risâletten emîr-i hac tâyin buyurulup ilk olarak bu sene hacc-ı İslâmî edâ edilmiş

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet personally performed and fully taught the rites at the Farewell Pilgrimage in 10 AH; he died the following year.
rows.anchor: bizzat Resûlullah ilk ve son olarak edâ-yı hac etmiş ve menâsik-i haccı tamamen tâlim buyurmuştur

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet's final hajj was certainly the obligatory performance, but the obligatory status of his earlier hajj performances is not established.
rows.anchor: Resûlullah’ın yaptığı bu son haccın edâ-yı farz için olduğunda şüphe yok ise de evvelkilerin farz olduğu sâbit değildir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This command conclusively requires completing an initiated hajj, not beginning one; Hajj became obligatory later through 3:97, and the Prophet performed it at the first opportunity.
rows.anchor: [Âl-i İmrân 3/97][^5] nassı ile farz kılınmış

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hajj might already have become obligatory through these verses during the compensatory umra, with prophetic performance delayed; jurists therefore dispute whether its obligation is immediate or deferred.
rows.anchor: farziyyet-i haccın fevrî veya gayr-i fevrî olması beyne’l-eimme muhtelefün fîhtir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abu Hanifa has two transmitted positions: Abu Yusuf prefers immediate performance, as does Malik; Shafi‘i's preferred view, like Muhammad's, allows delay.
rows.anchor: Esahhı Ebû Yûsuf rivayeti olan fevrdir. İmam Mâlik’ten muhtâr rivayet de budur. İmam Şâfiî’den muhtâr rivayet de İmam Muhammed gibi terâhîdir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hajj is the widest worshipful emblem of social unity, visibly realizing the Qur'anic gathering of humanity, with a reach no other place can match.
rows.anchor: tevhîd-i ictimâ‘îyi fiilen tecellî ettirecek olan en büyük ve en şâmil bir şi‘âr-ı ta‘abbüddür

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Kaaba is uniquely sacred, tied to Abraham's community across revealed religions and reportedly reaching back to Adam; Mecca's sanctity dates from the creation of the earth.
rows.anchor: Kâbe’nin millet-i İbrâhim’e alâkası bütün edyân-ı semâviyece müsellem ve hattâ Hazret-i Âdem’e kadar intihâsı da mervîdir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Later sanctuaries cannot serve universal unity because of their local particularity; even the Prophet's tomb, though its soil is superior to the Kaaba's, lacks the Kaaba's pilgrimage qualities.
rows.anchor: Hatta bizzat kabr-i nebevî türâb-ı Kâbe’den efdal olduğu hâlde Kâbe için mevcud olan devâ‘î ve hasâis-i hac bunda bile tasavvur olunamaz.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Seeking another Kaaba leads to shirk and division rather than unity in divine oneness.
rows.anchor: Bundan başka Kâbe arayanlar tevhîde değil, şirk ü tefrîke çalışmış olurlar.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hajj combines bodily worship like prayer with financial worship like almsgiving and also contains the meaning of jihad; a hadith calls hajj jihad and umra voluntary devotion.
rows.anchor: hac bir cihaddır, umre tetavvu‘dur.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Umra lexically means visitation and legally consists of ihram, tawaf, sa'y, and shaving or shortening; unlike hajj, it lacks standing at Arafat and has sa'y as a pillar.
rows.anchor: “Umre”, lügaten ziyaret mânasınadır. Şer‘an: İhram, tavaf, sa‘y, nihâyet halk veya taksîrden ibaret bir ziyâret-i mahsûsadır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Umra is a lesser hajj; he regards it as voluntary rather than obligatory, while acknowledging scholars who consider it obligatory.
rows.anchor: hükmen farkı da hac farzdır, umre farz değil, tetavvu‘olan bir ibadettir. Ma‘amâfîh göreceğimiz vechile bunun da farziyetine kāil olanlar vardır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He distinguishes three forms of hajj according to whether umra coincides with hajj during the pilgrimage months: ifrad, tamattu, and qiran.
rows.anchor: haccın üç nevi vardır. Hacc-ı ifrad, hacc-ı temettu‘, hacc-ı kıran.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ifrad is entering ihram from an outer miqat only for hajj, performing arrival tawaf, and remaining in ihram in Mecca through the hajj rites; he lists five outer miqats.
rows.anchor: Mîkāt-ı âfâkīden yalnız hac niyetiyle ihrâma girip tavâf-ı kudûmu yaptıktan sonra ef‘âl-i hac bitinceye kadar Mekke’de muhrim olarak kalmaktır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tamattu is performing umra and leaving ihram, remaining in Mecca, then entering hajj ihram at the sanctuary on the Day of Tarwiya and completing hajj with sacrifice.
rows.anchor: umre niyetiyle ihrâma girip umre için tavâfı ve sa‘yi yaparak tıraş olup

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Qiran begins with a joint intention for umra and hajj; the pilgrim performs both sets of rites and stays in ihram until hajj is complete, then sacrifices.
rows.anchor: hem umre ve hem hac ikisine birden niyet ile ihrâma girip Mekke’ye varınca evvelâ umre için tavaf ve sa‘y

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In pre-Islamic practice, combining umra and hajj during the hajj months was forbidden; the verse established their legitimacy and made sacrifice obligatory in gratitude.
rows.anchor: Câhiliyede umre ile haccın eşhur-i hacda ictimâ‘ı câiz değil idi, bu âyet bunların meşrû‘iyetini beyan için nâzil olmuş

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Completing hajj or umra means completing whichever one or both a person has begun, even if voluntary, without leaving it unfinished or deficient.
rows.anchor: velev nâfile olsun hac ve umreden birine veya ikisine başladınız mı tamamlayın, nâkıs bırakmayın

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command also means performing the rites fully, without omission from beginning to end.
rows.anchor: ne evvelinden ne âhirinden hiçbir noksan yapmayın.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because the Hudaybiya umra was interrupted by the polytheists, this year required its completion as a make-up and pointed toward the lawful forms of hajj.
rows.anchor: bu sene hem onun itmâmıyla kazâsı emredilmiş, hem de bu münasebetle müheyyâ-yı inkişaf bulunan haccın aksâm-ı meşrû‘asına da işaret buyurulmuştur.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The prohibition in 47:33 shows that even voluntary acts become binding once begun and must be made up if left incomplete.
rows.anchor: nevâfil bile şürû‘ile farz olur ve nâkıs bırakılırsa kazâsı lâzım gelir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The completion command does not conclusively establish an initial obligation: hajj was later made obligatory by 3:97, while no text establishes umra's independent obligation.
rows.anchor: umrenin re’sen vücûbuna dâir bir nas yoktur.

rows.speaker: Hazret-i Âişe, İbn Abbas, İbn Ömer, Hasan-ı Basrî, İbn Sîrîn
rows.claim: These authorities hold that umra is obligatory.
rows.anchor: Hazret-i Âişe ve İbn Abbas ve İbn Ömer, Hasan-ı Basrî, İbn Sîrîn, “umre vâcibdir” demişler

rows.speaker: İmam Şâfiî
rows.claim: Shafi‘i prefers the view that umra is obligatory, reasoning that the obligation to complete entails an obligation to begin.
rows.anchor: İmam Şâfiî de bunu ihtiyar eylemiş ve itmâmın vücûbu, aslın vücûbunu müstelzim olacağına zâhib olmuştur.

rows.speaker: Abdullah b. Mes‘ud, İbrâhim Nehaî, Şa‘bî
rows.claim: These authorities hold that umra is voluntary rather than obligatory.
rows.anchor: Abdullah b. Mes‘ud ve İbrâhim Nehaî ve Şa‘bî’den umrenin tetavvu‘olduğu rivayet edilmiş

rows.speaker: Mücâhid
rows.claim: Mujahid says the verse does not command people to undertake hajj and umra in the first place.
rows.anchor: Mücâhid dahi وَأَتِمُّوا۟ ٱلْحَجَّ وَٱلْعُمْرَةَ لِلَّهِ kavl-i ilâhîsinde “biz hac ve umre ile emr olunmadık” demiştir.

rows.speaker: Hazret-i Ali, Saîd b. Cübeyr, Tâvûs
rows.claim: They interpret completing hajj and umra as entering ihram for them from one's home.
rows.anchor: Hazret-i Ali’den ve Saîd b. Cübeyr’den ve Tâvûs’tan mervîdir ki “itmamları ehlinin evceğizinden bunlara ihram etmektir” demişler.

rows.speaker: Mücâhid
rows.claim: Mujahid interprets completion as carrying the rites through to their end after entering them.
rows.anchor: Mücâhid “itmamları bunlara duhûlden sonra nihâyetlerine ermektir” demiş

rows.speaker: Saîd b. Cübeyr, Atâ
rows.claim: They say both rites must be maintained for God's sake through completion because both are obligatory.
rows.anchor: Saîd b. Cübeyr ile Atâ “itmamları bunları nihâyetlerine kadar Allah için ikāme etmektir, çünkü ikisi de vâcibdir” demişler.

rows.speaker: İbn Ömer, Tâvûs
rows.claim: They interpret completion as performing hajj and umra separately.
rows.anchor: İbn Ömer ile Tâvûs’tan “itmamları ifrâdlarıdır”

rows.speaker: Katâde
rows.claim: Qatada says completing umra means performing it outside the months of hajj.
rows.anchor: Katâde de “itmâm-ı umre” umreyi hac aylarının gayrısında yapmak olduğuna kāil olmuştur.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The reported interpretations reduce to completing what one has begun or performing the rites wholly; the manner of full performance remains disputed, and ambiguity cannot establish a categorical obligation.
rows.anchor: Hâlbuki farziyet yani vücûb-ı kat‘î ihtimal ile sâbit olamayacağından

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the Hanafi school, umra is not an independently obligatory rite but a voluntary worship; as with other voluntary rites, beginning it makes completion binding.
rows.anchor: mezheb-i Hanefî’de umre ayrıca farz olan bir ibadet değildir. Hacda dâhil tetavvu‘ve nâfile kabîlinden bir ibadettir.

rows.speaker: Resûlullah
rows.claim: In response to Akra b. Habis, the Prophet says hajj is obligatory once, with additional performance voluntary.
rows.anchor: Resûlullah’ın “Bir keredir, ziyadesi [712] tetavvu‘dur” buyurduğu

rows.speaker: Câbir
rows.claim: A report from Jabir says umra remains included in hajj until the Day of Resurrection and describes hajj as jihad and umra as voluntary.
rows.anchor: hadîs-i Câbir’de “umre yevm-i kıyâmete kadar hacda dâhildir”

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He concludes there is no conclusive proof that umra is independently obligatory and cites an authentic report against that obligation.
rows.anchor: umrenin re’sen vücûbuna delîl-i kat‘î bulunmamakla beraber ‘adem-i vücûbuna dâir haber-i sahih de vardır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Even voluntary hajj or umra becomes binding to complete once begun and undertaken.
rows.anchor: şürû‘ve iltizam ile vâcib olacaklarından tamamlanmaları farz olduğunda da şüphe yoktur.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If a legal impediment prevents completion after ihram, the pilgrim must offer whatever hady is readily available.
rows.anchor: ihramdan sonra ihsar vâki‘olur, bir mâni‘-i mücbire tutulup hacdan veya umreden kalırsanız

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hady means sacrificial camels, cattle, or sheep dedicated to the Kaaba; a sheep or goat is the minimum, and one seventh of a camel or cow suffices.
rows.anchor: Hedy”, deve, sığır, davar cinsinden Beytullâh’a ihdâ olunan kurbanlıkların ismidir ki ekalli bir koyun veya keçidir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lexically ihsar is any prevention; legally it is being barred after ihram by a lawful excuse from the two pillars of hajj or from umra.
rows.anchor: “İhsar”, lügaten mutlak men‘mânasınadır. Şer‘an ihramdan sonra bir özr-i şer‘î ile haccın vakfe ve tavaf iki rüknünü de îfâdan veyahut umreden men‘edilmiş olmaktır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because the verse states ihsar without restriction, it includes enemy obstruction, illness or injury, loss of funds, and a woman's loss of her mahram.
rows.anchor: Âyette ihsar mutlaktır, binâen‘aleyh gerek düşmanın men‘i ve gerek kırıklık, topallık gibi bir maraz veya zayâ‘-ı nafaka veya kadın hakkında fevt-i mahrem mâni‘alarının men‘i dahi ihsardır.

rows.speaker: İmam Şâfiî
rows.claim: Shafi‘i restricts ihsar to obstruction by an enemy, based on the occasion of revelation.
rows.anchor: Fakat İmam Şâfiî sebeb-i nüzûl dolayısıyla yalnız düşmanın men‘ine hasr etmiştir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: To allow release from ihram without waiting at least a year to finish the rites, the law requires sending a hady when ihsar occurs.
rows.anchor: teysir için ihsar hâlinde meşrû‘an ihramdan çıkabilmek üzere sevk-i hedy vâcib kılınmıştır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hady's destination is within the Haram according to 5:95; the pilgrim arranges a day with the person sent and may shave after reasonably believing the sacrifice was made.
rows.anchor: Zira hedyin “mahill”i هَدْيًۢا بَٰلِغَ ٱلْكَعْبَةِ [el-Mâide 5/95][^21] mantûkunca dâhil-i Harem’dir.

rows.speaker: İbn Mes‘ud, İbn Abbas, Atâ, Tâvûs, Mücâhid, Hasan, İbn Sîrîn
rows.claim: These authorities, along with the Hanafis and Sufyan al-Thawri, hold that the hady must reach the Haram before the pilgrim shaves and exits ihram.
rows.anchor: Abdullah b. Mes‘ud, İbn Abbas, Atâ, Tâvûs, Mücâhid, Hasan, İbn Sîrîn buna kāil olmuşlardır.

rows.speaker: İmam Mâlik, İmam Şâfiî
rows.claim: Malik and Shafi‘i say the hady may be slaughtered at the place of obstruction, which is its destination for the prevented pilgrim.
rows.anchor: Lâkin İmam Mâlik ve Şâfiî muhsar için mahill-i hedyin mevki‘-i ihsar olduğuna ve mahilline bülûğu da o mevkide zebhinden ibaret bulunduğuna kāil olmuşlardır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He rejects that interpretation: Hudaybiya straddled the Hill and Haram, the Prophet camped in the Hill but prayed in the Haram, and his camp was on the Mecca-facing Haram side.
rows.anchor: Hudeybiye’nin bir tarafı Hil, bir tarafı Harem’dir. Resûlullah’ın konak yeri Hil’de, musallâsı da Harem tarafında idi

rows.speaker: Zührî
rows.claim: Al-Zuhri explicitly transmits that the Prophet slaughtered his hady within the Haram.
rows.anchor: Resûlullah’ın hedyini Harem’de boğazlamış olduğu da Zührî’den sarâhaten menkuldür.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He finds no basis for interpreting the verse against its apparent meaning; without an available hady, the prevented pilgrim remains in ihram until one is available or tawaf can be performed.
rows.anchor: nass-ı âyeti zâhirinin hilâfına haml etmeye mahal yoktur. Demek ki her iki takdirde hedy müyesser olmazsa müyesser oluncaya veya tavaf edinceye kadar muhsar ihrâmında kalmaya mecbur olacaktır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A person who sent a hady cannot shave before it reaches its destination.
rows.anchor: Hedyi gönderen de mahalline bülûğundan evvel tıraş olamayacaktır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A pilgrim who must shave early because of illness or head irritation owes one of three forms of fidya: fasting, charity, or sacrifice.
rows.anchor: ona da oruç veya sadaka veya kurban, bu üç nev‘in birinden bir fidye vâcib

rows.speaker: Resûlullah
rows.claim: At Hudaybiya the Prophet saw lice troubling Ka'b b. Ujra and allowed him to shave, fast three days, feed six poor people dates, or sacrifice a sheep.
rows.anchor: “tıraş ol da üç gün oruç tut veya altı miskîne bir fark hurma tasadduk et veya bir koyun kurban kes” diye emretmişti.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One farq equals three sa; another narration says six sa, which he considers the preferable wording.
rows.anchor: Bir fark üç sâ‘dır. Bu hadîsin bir rivayetinde altı sâ‘tâbiri vardır ki bu daha evlâdır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although revelation arose from obstruction and lice, the verse applies generally to prevented and unprevented pilgrims and every kind of illness or injury.
rows.anchor: mantûk-ı âyet muhsar ve gayr-i muhsar ve her nevi maraz ve ezâya âmdır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The concession extends to any ihram prohibition made necessary by illness or injury, including clothing or perfume, provided fidya is paid.
rows.anchor: hüküm hâl-i ihramdaki mahzûrât-ı haccın hepsine şâmil olarak fidye şartıyla ruhsatı tazammun eder

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When safe or unrestricted, one who joins umra to hajj owes hady, whether doing qiran or leaving ihram after umra and later doing tamattu.
rows.anchor: her kim hac zamanına kadar umre ile istifade etmek, yani umreyi hacca terfik ederek hacc-ı kıran yapmak veya umreden tehallül ile hac ihrâmına kadar serbest kalmak

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hady is obligatory for both qiran and tamattu pilgrims.
rows.anchor: hacc-ı kıran veya hacc-ı temettu‘yapanların hedy gönderip nihâyette bir kurban kesmeleri vâcibtir.

rows.speaker: İmam Şâfiî
rows.claim: Shafi‘i treats this as a compensatory sacrifice for the deficiency of joining umra and hajj, so its owner may not eat it; the Prophet and Malik are said to prefer ifrad.
rows.anchor: bu kurban İmam Şâfiî’ye göre dem-i cebirdir, sâhibi yiyemez.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Hanafi school calls it a thanksgiving sacrifice: qiran is better than tamattu, and tamattu better than ifrad, since combining the two rites is a blessing after abolishing pre-Islamic custom; the pilgrim may eat it.
rows.anchor: Çünkü haddizâtında kıran temettu‘dan, temettu‘

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The disagreement stems from conflicting reports about which form of hajj the Prophet performed at the Farewell Pilgrimage.
rows.anchor: Bu ihtilâfın sebebi de Haccetü’l-vedâ‘da Resûlullah’ın haccı hangisi olduğu hakkındaki rivâyâtın ihtilâfıdır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He identifies as the strongest, most comprehensive basis an authentic report from Jabir through Ja'far al-Sadiq and his father, cited in Sahih Muslim and other hadith collections.
rows.anchor: Ca‘fer-i Sâdık hazretlerinden pederi tarîkiyle Câbir b. Abdillâh radıyallahu ‘anh hazretlerinden vâki‘olan rivâyet-i sahîhadır.
